archetype.basis: No registered archetype has a dogleg gate. Six curated dogleg cars share an identical block - five forward gears, first down and left, clutch to pull away, a lift on upshifts and a blip on every downshift - and would form one, but every one of them leaves gearbox_type unknown and an archetype must be fully specified. A reviewed source establishing the construction on any of them creates the archetype this record belongs to.
